locked_problem: A passage feels choppy because three consecutive paragraphs each restart the same reader-state fact before the character decides whether to enter the room.

variant_mechanical_smoothing.method: vary sentence length, replace repeated words, combine two short paragraphs

variant_upstream_repair.method: remove duplicate reader-state resets; make paragraph 1 establish object, paragraph 2 show action against it, paragraph 3 carry implication into the decision; preserve character-specific diction

conclusion: Sentence variety is not the primary fix when choppiness originates in repeated scene/paragraph state. Route upward first; sentence-level polish follows only after the causal/topic chain is sound.
human_boundary: No claim of human preference or literary excellence is made from this fixture.
